The '''Imperial Power Bureau''' was a department of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that dealt with power generators and other energy matters. This bureau fell under the purview of the [[Sphere of Technology]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
